# Language Change Event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageChangeEvent`](gmeow-LanguageChangeEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageChangeEvent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

A historical linguistic change — sound shifts, semantic drift, borrowing, spelling reform, grammatical change, lexical innovation, standardization, language contact, extinction, revival, or revitalization. Follows the [`LanguageCreation`](gmeow-LanguageCreation.md) pattern as an [`Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md) subclass; change type is an open value vocabulary ([`gmeow:LanguageChangeType`](gmeow-LanguageChangeType.md)) and affected languages are linked via [`gmeow:affectedLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-affectedLanguage.md). Temporal placement and participation reuse the universal events machinery.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageChangeEvent`](gmeow-LanguageChangeEvent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
